items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] How did Caffrey play? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah. What was his name? Oh, yeah. Solos and chords and picking his song out and everything.

ctx.x: I and George Geno started to play in banjo just about the same year.
How did Caffrey play? Any special, like his solos or just musical chords?
Oh, yeah. What was his name? Oh, yeah. Solos and chords and picking his song out and everything.
